title: Maximal Square Area - Solution
intuition: Given an m x n binary matrix filled with 0's and 1's, find the largest square containing only 1's and return its area.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: State dp[i][j] holds max square side length ending at cell. Transition: if cell is 1, min(top, left, top-left) + 1.
